net.name: Butterfly Net
net.description: Cane, wire and muslin, mended twice. There is a name inked on the handle and it has been scratched out with the same pen.

butterfly.name: Butterfly
butterfly.description: In the net, then in your hand, and quite still. It is warmer than it ought to be.

butterfly_amulet.name: Butterfly Amulet
butterfly_amulet.description: Eight wings set in glass, in the order the cases were labelled. The last case had no label on it and now it does.
